## R Markdown

#create the net availability and run 
```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(viridis)
library(scales)
library(here)

# Check if corrected data exists, if not, use the main corrected data to create it
net_availability_path <- here("output_data", "Climate_MSP_Analysis_2024_Corrected", "constraint_impact_analysis", "additional_plots", "net_availability_analysis_CORRECTED.csv")
constraint_impact_path <- here("output_data", "Climate_MSP_Analysis_2024_Corrected", "constraint_impact_analysis", "constraint_impact_on_analogues.csv")

# If the constraint impact analysis files don't exist, create them from the main corrected data
if (!file.exists(net_availability_path) || !file.exists(constraint_impact_path)) {
  cat("Corrected constraint impact analysis files not found. Creating from main corrected data...\n")
  
  # Create directories
  dir.create(here("output_data", "Climate_MSP_Analysis_2024_Corrected", "constraint_impact_analysis", "additional_plots"), 
             recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  # Load the main corrected data
  area_results_corrected <- read.csv(here("output_data", "Climate_MSP_Analysis_2024_Corrected", "area_results_marine_zones_with_constraints_CORRECTED.csv"))
  
  # Create net availability analysis
  net_availability_corrected <- area_results_corrected %>%
    mutate(
      # Calculate net availability (can be negative if constraints > high confidence)
      Net_Available_km2 = High_Confidence_km2 - Unsuitable_Constraints_km2,
      # Convert to percentage of total zone area
      Total_Zone_Area_km2 = No_Analog_km2 + Low_Confidence_km2 + Medium_Confidence_km2 + 
                           High_Confidence_km2 + Unsuitable_Constraints_km2,
      Net_Available_Pct = Net_Available_km2 / Total_Zone_Area_km2 * 100,
      # Add categorical variable for easier interpretation
      Availability_Status = case_when(
        Net_Available_km2 > 0 ~ "Net Positive",
        Net_Available_km2 < 0 ~ "Net Negative",
        TRUE ~ "Neutral"
      )
    )
  
  # Create constraint impact analysis
  constraint_impact_corrected <- area_results_corrected %>%
    group_by(SSP, Decade, Pattern, Marine_Zone) %>%
    # Calculate various metrics
    summarize(
      # Total climate suitable area (all confidence levels)
      Climate_Suitable_km2 = sum(Low_Confidence_km2, Medium_Confidence_km2, High_Confidence_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
      # High confidence area specifically
      High_Confidence_km2 = sum(High_Confidence_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
      # Constraint area
      Constraint_Area_km2 = sum(Unsuitable_Constraints_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
      # Total area of the zone
      Total_Zone_Area_km2 = sum(No_Analog_km2, Low_Confidence_km2, Medium_Confidence_km2, 
                              High_Confidence_km2, Unsuitable_Constraints_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
      # Calculate percentages and ratios
      Suitable_Percentage = Climate_Suitable_km2 / Total_Zone_Area_km2 * 100,
      High_Conf_Percentage = High_Confidence_km2 / Total_Zone_Area_km2 * 100,
      Constraint_Percentage = Constraint_Area_km2 / Total_Zone_Area_km2 * 100,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    # For cleaner plotting, create decade order
    mutate(
      Decade_num = as.numeric(gsub("_.*", "", Decade)),
      Decade = factor(Decade, levels = unique(Decade[order(Decade_num)]))
    )
  
  # Save the created files
  write.csv(net_availability_corrected, net_availability_path, row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(constraint_impact_corrected, constraint_impact_path, row.names = FALSE)
  
  cat("Created corrected constraint impact analysis files.\n")
} else {
  # Load existing corrected data
  net_availability_corrected <- read.csv(net_availability_path)
  constraint_impact_corrected <- read.csv(constraint_impact_path)
}

# Current aquaculture usage
current_usage <- 25.88

# Create output directory for corrected plots
data_folder <- here("output_data", "Climate_MSP_Analysis_2024_Corrected", "plots")
dir.create(data_folder, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Prepare the constrained data (net available after constraints) - CORRECTED
constrained_data_corrected <- net_availability_corrected %>%
  dplyr::select(SSP, Decade, Pattern, Marine_Zone, Net_Available_km2) %>%
  mutate(
    SSP = factor(SSP, levels = c("ssp119", "ssp126", "ssp245", "ssp370", "ssp585")),
    Pattern = factor(Pattern, levels = c("suitable", "optimal")),
    Marine_Zone = case_when(
      Marine_Zone == "Coastal waters and territorial seas (state waters)" ~ "State Waters",
      Marine_Zone == "Commonwealth Waters" ~ "Commonwealth Waters", 
      Marine_Zone == "High Seas" ~ "High Seas",
      TRUE ~ Marine_Zone
    ),
    Marine_Zone = factor(Marine_Zone, levels = c("State Waters", "Commonwealth Waters", "High Seas")),
    Data_Type = "Constrained",
    Area_km2 = pmax(Net_Available_km2, 0) # Set negative values to 0 for plotting
  )

# Prepare the unconstrained data (high confidence climate analogues) - CORRECTED
unconstrained_data_corrected <- constraint_impact_corrected %>%
  dplyr::select(SSP, Decade, Pattern, Marine_Zone, High_Confidence_km2) %>%
  mutate(
    SSP = factor(SSP, levels = c("ssp119", "ssp126", "ssp245", "ssp370", "ssp585")),
    Pattern = factor(Pattern, levels = c("suitable", "optimal")),
    Marine_Zone = case_when(
      Marine_Zone == "Coastal waters and territorial seas (state waters)" ~ "State Waters",
      Marine_Zone == "Commonwealth Waters" ~ "Commonwealth Waters",
      Marine_Zone == "High Seas" ~ "High Seas",
      TRUE ~ Marine_Zone
    ),
    Marine_Zone = factor(Marine_Zone, levels = c("State Waters", "Commonwealth Waters", "High Seas")),
    Data_Type = "Unconstrained",
    Area_km2 = High_Confidence_km2
  )

# Combine both datasets - CORRECTED
combined_data_corrected <- bind_rows(
  constrained_data_corrected %>% dplyr::select(SSP, Decade, Pattern, Marine_Zone, Data_Type, Area_km2),
  unconstrained_data_corrected %>% dplyr::select(SSP, Decade, Pattern, Marine_Zone, Data_Type, Area_km2)
) %>%
  mutate(
    Decade_num = as.numeric(str_extract(Decade, "\\d{4}")),
    SSP_label = case_when(
      SSP == "ssp119" ~ "SSP1-1.9",
      SSP == "ssp126" ~ "SSP1-2.6", 
      SSP == "ssp245" ~ "SSP2-4.5",
      SSP == "ssp370" ~ "SSP3-7.0",
      SSP == "ssp585" ~ "SSP5-8.5"
    ),
    Pattern_Type = paste(Pattern, Data_Type, sep = "_")
  )

# Create the corrected plot with matching viridis colors
area_comparison_plot_corrected <- ggplot(combined_data_corrected, aes(x = Decade_num, y = Area_km2, color = SSP_label)) +
  # Add current usage reference line
  geom_hline(yintercept = current_usage, color = "black", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
  
  # Add lines for each pattern and data type
  geom_line(aes(linetype = Pattern_Type), linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  
  # Facet by marine territory (ordered: State Waters, Commonwealth Waters, High Seas)
  facet_wrap(~ Marine_Zone, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  
  # Use the same viridis plasma colors as your other plots
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "SSP Scenario",
    values = c(
      "SSP1-1.9" = "#0d0887", 
      "SSP1-2.6" = "#8606a6",  
      "SSP2-4.5" = "#c03a83",   
      "SSP3-7.0" = "#e76f5a",   
      "SSP5-8.5" = "#fcd225"     
    )
  ) +
  
  # Configure line types
  scale_linetype_manual(
    name = "Pattern & Constraints",
    values = c(
      "suitable_Constrained" = "solid",
      "optimal_Constrained" = "dashed",
      "suitable_Unconstrained" = "dotdash", 
      "optimal_Unconstrained" = "longdash"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "suitable_Constrained" = "Suitable (Constrained)",
      "optimal_Constrained" = "Optimal (Constrained)",
      "suitable_Unconstrained" = "Suitable (Unconstrained)",
      "optimal_Unconstrained" = "Optimal (Unconstrained)"
    )
  ) +
  
  # Format axes
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = "Decade",
    breaks = seq(2020, 2100, 20),
    labels = seq(2020, 2100, 20)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Area (km²)",
    labels = label_comma()
  ) +
  
  # Customize theme
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey90"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey90"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12)
  ) +
  
  # Add labels with corrected note
  labs(
    title = "Climate Analogue Areas: Constrained vs Unconstrained by Marine Territory (CORRECTED)",
    subtitle = "Comparison of net available area after spatial constraints vs theoretical climate suitable area\nHigh Seas now properly excludes terrestrial areas",
    caption = "Dotted black line shows current aquaculture usage (25.88 km²)"
  )

# Display the corrected plot
print(area_comparison_plot_corrected)

# Save the corrected plot
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(data_folder, "area_available_constrained_vs_unconstrained_by_territory_CORRECTED_new.png"),
  plot = area_comparison_plot_corrected,
  width = 14, height = 12, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
)

# Create a version with log scale for better visualization of State Waters
area_comparison_plot_log_corrected <- area_comparison_plot_corrected +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Area (km²) - Log Scale", 
    labels = label_comma(),
    trans = "log10"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Climate Analogue Areas: Constrained vs Unconstrained by Marine Territory (CORRECTED - Log Scale)",
    subtitle = "Log scale version for better visualization across all marine zones\nHigh Seas now properly excludes terrestrial areas",
    caption = "Dotted black line shows current aquaculture usage (25.88 km²)"
  )

print(area_comparison_plot_log_corrected)

# Save the log scale version
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(data_folder, "area_available_constrained_vs_unconstrained_by_territory_log_CORRECTED_new.png"),
  plot = area_comparison_plot_log_corrected,
  width = 14, height = 12, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
)

# Create summary statistics comparing corrected vs uncorrected if original data exists
original_net_path <- here("output_data", "Climate_MSP_Analysis_2024", "constraint_impact_analysis", "additional_plots", "net_availability_analysis.csv")

if (file.exists(original_net_path)) {
  # Load original data for comparison
  net_availability_original <- read.csv(original_net_path)
  
  # Create comparison of High Seas areas
  high_seas_comparison <- bind_rows(
    net_availability_original %>% 
      filter(Marine_Zone == "High Seas") %>%
      dplyr::select(SSP, Decade, Pattern, Net_Available_km2) %>%
      mutate(Data_Version = "Original (with terrestrial)"),
    net_availability_corrected %>% 
      filter(Marine_Zone == "High Seas") %>%
      dplyr::select(SSP, Decade, Pattern, Net_Available_km2) %>%
      mutate(Data_Version = "Corrected (marine only)")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    SSP_label = case_when(
      SSP == "ssp119" ~ "SSP1-1.9",
      SSP == "ssp126" ~ "SSP1-2.6", 
      SSP == "ssp245" ~ "SSP2-4.5",
      SSP == "ssp370" ~ "SSP3-7.0",
      SSP == "ssp585" ~ "SSP5-8.5"
    ),
    Decade_num = as.numeric(str_extract(Decade, "\\d{4}"))
  )
  
  # Create comparison plot for High Seas only
  high_seas_comparison_plot <- ggplot(high_seas_comparison, 
                                     aes(x = Decade_num, y = pmax(Net_Available_km2, 0), 
                                         color = SSP_label, linetype = Data_Version)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    facet_wrap(~ Pattern, labeller = labeller(Pattern = c("optimal" = "Optimal", "suitable" = "Suitable"))) +
    scale_color_manual(
      name = "SSP Scenario",
      values = c(
       "SSP1-1.9" = "#0d0887", 
      "SSP1-2.6" = "#8606a6",  
      "SSP2-4.5" = "#c03a83",   
      "SSP3-7.0" = "#e76f5a",   
      "SSP5-8.5" = "#fcd225"      
      )
    ) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c("Original (with terrestrial)" = "dashed", 
                "Corrected (marine only)" = "solid"),
      name = "Data Version"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      name = "Decade",
      breaks = seq(2020, 2100, 20),
      labels = seq(2020, 2100, 20)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = "Net Available Area (km²)",
      labels = label_comma()
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "High Seas: Impact of Terrestrial Exclusion on Net Available Area",
      subtitle = "Comparison between original (with land) and corrected (marine only) calculations",
      caption = "Corrected version properly excludes terrestrial areas from High Seas calculations"
    )
  
  # Save comparison plot
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(data_folder, "high_seas_net_availability_original_vs_corrected_comparison_new.png"),
    plot = high_seas_comparison_plot,
    width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
  )
  
  # Save comparison data
  write.csv(high_seas_comparison, 
            file.path(data_folder, "high_seas_net_availability_comparison_data.csv"), 
            row.names = FALSE)
  
  cat("High Seas comparison plot created showing impact of terrestrial exclusion!\n")
}

# Print summary statistics for corrected data
cat("CORRECTED DATA ANALYSIS SUMMARY\n")
cat("===============================\n")
cat("Key changes:\n")
cat("- High Seas areas now properly exclude terrestrial areas\n")
cat("- Net availability calculations use corrected marine boundaries\n")
cat("- Consistent viridis color scheme maintained\n")
cat("\n")

# Create summary table
summary_stats_corrected <- combined_data_corrected %>%
  group_by(Marine_Zone, Data_Type, Pattern) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Area = mean(Area_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max_Area = max(Area_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min_Area = min(Area_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Marine_Zone, Data_Type, Pattern)

print(summary_stats_corrected)

# Save summary statistics
write.csv(summary_stats_corrected, 
          file.path(data_folder, "area_comparison_summary_statistics_CORRECTED.csv"), 
          row.names = FALSE)

# Print confirmation of where files were saved
cat("\nCorrected figures saved to:", normalizePath(data_folder), "\n")
cat("Files created:\n")
cat("- area_available_constrained_vs_unconstrained_by_territory_CORRECTED.png\n")
cat("- area_available_constrained_vs_unconstrained_by_territory_log_CORRECTED.png\n")
if (file.exists(original_net_path)) {
  cat("- high_seas_net_availability_original_vs_corrected_comparison.png\n")
}
cat("- area_comparison_summary_statistics_CORRECTED.csv\n")
```

#make the plots with different colors for unconstrained and constrained climate analogues
```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(viridis)
library(scales)
library(here)

# Check if corrected data exists, if not, use the main corrected data to create it
net_availability_path <- here("output_data", "Climate_MSP_Analysis_2024_Corrected", "constraint_impact_analysis", "additional_plots", "net_availability_analysis_CORRECTED.csv")
constraint_impact_path <- here("output_data", "Climate_MSP_Analysis_2024_Corrected", "constraint_impact_analysis", "constraint_impact_on_analogues.csv")

# If the constraint impact analysis files don't exist, create them from the main corrected data
if (!file.exists(net_availability_path) || !file.exists(constraint_impact_path)) {
  cat("Corrected constraint impact analysis files not found. Creating from main corrected data...\n")
  
  # Create directories
  dir.create(here("output_data", "Climate_MSP_Analysis_2024_Corrected", "constraint_impact_analysis", "additional_plots"), 
             recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  # Load the main corrected data
  area_results_corrected <- read.csv(here("output_data", "Climate_MSP_Analysis_2024_Corrected", "area_results_marine_zones_with_constraints_CORRECTED.csv"))
  
  # Create net availability analysis
  net_availability_corrected <- area_results_corrected %>%
    mutate(
      # Calculate net availability (can be negative if constraints > high confidence)
      Net_Available_km2 = High_Confidence_km2 - Unsuitable_Constraints_km2,
      # Convert to percentage of total zone area
      Total_Zone_Area_km2 = No_Analog_km2 + Low_Confidence_km2 + Medium_Confidence_km2 + 
                           High_Confidence_km2 + Unsuitable_Constraints_km2,
      Net_Available_Pct = Net_Available_km2 / Total_Zone_Area_km2 * 100,
      # Add categorical variable for easier interpretation
      Availability_Status = case_when(
        Net_Available_km2 > 0 ~ "Net Positive",
        Net_Available_km2 < 0 ~ "Net Negative",
        TRUE ~ "Neutral"
      )
    )
  
  # Create constraint impact analysis
  constraint_impact_corrected <- area_results_corrected %>%
    group_by(SSP, Decade, Pattern, Marine_Zone) %>%
    # Calculate various metrics
    summarize(
      # Total climate suitable area (all confidence levels)
      Climate_Suitable_km2 = sum(Low_Confidence_km2, Medium_Confidence_km2, High_Confidence_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
      # High confidence area specifically
      High_Confidence_km2 = sum(High_Confidence_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
      # Constraint area
      Constraint_Area_km2 = sum(Unsuitable_Constraints_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
      # Total area of the zone
      Total_Zone_Area_km2 = sum(No_Analog_km2, Low_Confidence_km2, Medium_Confidence_km2, 
                              High_Confidence_km2, Unsuitable_Constraints_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
      # Calculate percentages and ratios
      Suitable_Percentage = Climate_Suitable_km2 / Total_Zone_Area_km2 * 100,
      High_Conf_Percentage = High_Confidence_km2 / Total_Zone_Area_km2 * 100,
      Constraint_Percentage = Constraint_Area_km2 / Total_Zone_Area_km2 * 100,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    # For cleaner plotting, create decade order
    mutate(
      Decade_num = as.numeric(gsub("_.*", "", Decade)),
      Decade = factor(Decade, levels = unique(Decade[order(Decade_num)]))
    )
  
  # Save the created files
  write.csv(net_availability_corrected, net_availability_path, row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(constraint_impact_corrected, constraint_impact_path, row.names = FALSE)
  
  cat("Created corrected constraint impact analysis files.\n")
} else {
  # Load existing corrected data
  net_availability_corrected <- read.csv(net_availability_path)
  constraint_impact_corrected <- read.csv(constraint_impact_path)
}

# Current aquaculture usage
current_usage <- 25.88

# Create output directory for corrected plots
data_folder <- here("output_data", "Climate_MSP_Analysis_2024_Corrected", "plots")
dir.create(data_folder, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Prepare the constrained data (net available after constraints) - CORRECTED
constrained_data_corrected <- net_availability_corrected %>%
  dplyr::select(SSP, Decade, Pattern, Marine_Zone, Net_Available_km2) %>%
  mutate(
    SSP = factor(SSP, levels = c("ssp119", "ssp126", "ssp245", "ssp370", "ssp585")),
    Pattern = factor(Pattern, levels = c("suitable", "optimal")),
    Marine_Zone = case_when(
      Marine_Zone == "Coastal waters and territorial seas (state waters)" ~ "State Waters",
      Marine_Zone == "Commonwealth Waters" ~ "Commonwealth Waters", 
      Marine_Zone == "High Seas" ~ "High Seas",
      TRUE ~ Marine_Zone
    ),
    Marine_Zone = factor(Marine_Zone, levels = c("State Waters", "Commonwealth Waters", "High Seas")),
    Data_Type = "Constrained",
    Area_km2 = pmax(Net_Available_km2, 0) # Set negative values to 0 for plotting
  )

# Prepare the unconstrained data (high confidence climate analogues) - CORRECTED
unconstrained_data_corrected <- constraint_impact_corrected %>%
  dplyr::select(SSP, Decade, Pattern, Marine_Zone, High_Confidence_km2) %>%
  mutate(
    SSP = factor(SSP, levels = c("ssp119", "ssp126", "ssp245", "ssp370", "ssp585")),
    Pattern = factor(Pattern, levels = c("suitable", "optimal")),
    Marine_Zone = case_when(
      Marine_Zone == "Coastal waters and territorial seas (state waters)" ~ "State Waters",
      Marine_Zone == "Commonwealth Waters" ~ "Commonwealth Waters",
      Marine_Zone == "High Seas" ~ "High Seas",
      TRUE ~ Marine_Zone
    ),
    Marine_Zone = factor(Marine_Zone, levels = c("State Waters", "Commonwealth Waters", "High Seas")),
    Data_Type = "Unconstrained",
    Area_km2 = High_Confidence_km2
  )

# Combine both datasets - CORRECTED
combined_data_corrected <- bind_rows(
  constrained_data_corrected %>% dplyr::select(SSP, Decade, Pattern, Marine_Zone, Data_Type, Area_km2),
  unconstrained_data_corrected %>% dplyr::select(SSP, Decade, Pattern, Marine_Zone, Data_Type, Area_km2)
) %>%
  mutate(
    Decade_num = as.numeric(str_extract(Decade, "\\d{4}")),
    SSP_label = case_when(
      SSP == "ssp119" ~ "SSP1-1.9",
      SSP == "ssp126" ~ "SSP1-2.6", 
      SSP == "ssp245" ~ "SSP2-4.5",
      SSP == "ssp370" ~ "SSP3-7.0",
      SSP == "ssp585" ~ "SSP5-8.5"
    ),
    Pattern_Type = paste(Pattern, Data_Type, sep = "_")
  )

# Create the corrected plot with side-by-side facets
area_comparison_plot_corrected <- ggplot(combined_data_corrected, aes(x = Decade_num, y = Area_km2, color = SSP_label)) +
  # Add current usage reference line
  geom_hline(yintercept = current_usage, color = "black", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
  
  # Add lines for each pattern
  geom_line(aes(linetype = Pattern), linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  
  # Facet by marine territory AND data type (side by side)
  facet_grid(Marine_Zone ~ Data_Type, scales = "free_y") +
  
  # Use the same viridis colors for both constrained and unconstrained
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "SSP Scenario",
    values = c(
      "SSP1-1.9" = "#0d0887", 
      "SSP1-2.6" = "#8606a6",  
      "SSP2-4.5" = "#c03a83",   
      "SSP3-7.0" = "#e76f5a",   
      "SSP5-8.5" = "#fcd225"   
    )
  ) +
  
  # Configure line types for patterns
  scale_linetype_manual(
    name = "Pattern",
    values = c("suitable" = "solid", "optimal" = "dashed"),
    labels = c("suitable" = "Suitable", "optimal" = "Optimal")
  ) +
  
  # Format axes
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = "Decade",
    breaks = seq(2020, 2100, 20),
    labels = seq(2020, 2100, 20)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Area (km²)",
    labels = label_comma()
  ) +
  
  # Customize theme
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey90"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey90"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12)
  ) +
  
  # Add labels with corrected note
  labs(
    title = "Climate Analogue Areas: Constrained vs Unconstrained by Marine Territory (CORRECTED)",
    subtitle = "Side-by-side comparison of net available area after spatial constraints vs theoretical climate suitable area\nHigh Seas now properly excludes terrestrial areas",
    caption = "Dotted black line shows current aquaculture usage (25.88 km²)"
  )

# Display the corrected plot
print(area_comparison_plot_corrected)

# Create alternative version with different visual styling for constrained vs unconstrained
area_comparison_plot_dual_colors <- ggplot() +

  geom_point(data = combined_data_corrected %>% filter(Data_Type == "Unconstrained"),

if (file.exists(original_net_path)) {

      "SSP5-8.5" = "#fcd225"   
      )

    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c("Original (with terrestrial)" = "dashed", 
                "Corrected (marine only)" = "solid"),
      name = "Data Version"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      name = "Decade",
      breaks = seq(2020, 2100, 20),
      labels = seq(2020, 2100, 20)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = "Net Available Area (km²)",
      labels = label_comma()
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +

      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

      legend.position = "bottom",
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "High Seas: Impact of Terrestrial Exclusion on Net Available Area",
      subtitle = "Comparison between original (with land) and corrected (marine only) calculations",
      caption = "Corrected version properly excludes terrestrial areas from High Seas calculations"

# Print summary statistics for corrected data

cat("- area_comparison_summary_statistics_CORRECTED.csv\n")
```

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(viridis)
library(scales)
library(here)
library(patchwork)

# ===========================
# STEP 1: Load and prepare base data
# ===========================

# Load your CSV data
area_results_sum <- read_csv(
  here("output_data/ESM_Agreement_Plots_Area_CORRECTED/area_results_marine_zones_CORRECTED.csv"), 
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Create current aquaculture reference
current_aqua <- data.frame(
  Decade = "Current",
  High_Confidence_km2 = 25.88,
  SSP = "Current",
  Pattern = "suitable",
  Marine_Zone = "Total"
)

# ===========================
# STEP 2: Create df_combined properly
# ===========================

# Sum across all marine zones to get totals
df_combined <- area_results_sum %>%
  group_by(SSP, Decade, Pattern) %>%
  summarise(High_Confidence_km2 = sum(High_Confidence_km2, na.rm = TRUE), 
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  bind_rows(current_aqua %>% select(SSP, Decade, Pattern, High_Confidence_km2))

# Define decade order
decade_order <- c("Current", "2021_2030", "2031_2040", "2041_2050", 
                  "2051_2060", "2061_2070", "2071_2080", 
                  "2081_2090", "2091_2100")

# ===========================
# STEP 3: Prepare zone-level data
# ===========================

# Prepare individual zone data with SSP labels
zone_data <- area_results_sum %>%
  mutate(
    SSP_label = case_when(
      SSP == "ssp119" ~ "SSP1-1.9",
      SSP == "ssp126" ~ "SSP1-2.6", 
      SSP == "ssp245" ~ "SSP2-4.5",
      SSP == "ssp370" ~ "SSP3-7.0",
      SSP == "ssp585" ~ "SSP5-8.5"
    ),
    Marine_Zone = case_when(
      Marine_Zone == "Coastal waters and territorial seas (state waters)" ~ "State Waters",
      Marine_Zone == "Commonwealth Waters" ~ "Commonwealth Waters",
      Marine_Zone == "High Seas" ~ "High Seas",
      TRUE ~ Marine_Zone
    ),
    Marine_Zone = factor(Marine_Zone, levels = c("State Waters", "Commonwealth Waters", "High Seas")),
    Decade_factor = factor(Decade, levels = decade_order[-1]),  # Exclude "Current"
    Area_km2 = High_Confidence_km2
  )

# ===========================
# STEP 4: Helper function for decade formatting
# ===========================

format_decades <- function(decade_factor) {
  decade_str <- as.character(decade_factor)
  decade_str <- str_replace_all(decade_str, "_", "-")
  factor(decade_str, 
         levels = c("2021-2030", "2031-2040", "2041-2050", 
                   "2051-2060", "2061-2070", "2071-2080", 
                   "2081-2090", "2091-2100"))
}

# ===========================
# STEP 5: Create combined dataset for unified plots
# ===========================

# Prepare total data
total_data <- df_combined %>%
  filter(Decade != "Current") %>%
  mutate(
    Marine_Zone = "Total Area",
    SSP_label = case_when(
      SSP == "ssp119" ~ "SSP1-1.9",
      SSP == "ssp126" ~ "SSP1-2.6", 
      SSP == "ssp245" ~ "SSP2-4.5",
      SSP == "ssp370" ~ "SSP3-7.0",
      SSP == "ssp585" ~ "SSP5-8.5",
      TRUE ~ SSP
    ),
    Decade_factor = factor(Decade, levels = decade_order[-1]),
    Area_km2 = High_Confidence_km2
  ) %>%
  select(SSP_label, Decade_factor, Pattern, Marine_Zone, Area_km2)

# Combine total and zone data
all_data <- bind_rows(
  total_data,
  zone_data %>% select(SSP_label, Decade_factor, Pattern, Marine_Zone, Area_km2)
) %>%
  mutate(Decade_factor = format_decades(Decade_factor))

# ===========================
# STEP 6: Define color palette to match original
# ===========================

# Matching your original plot's colors (viridis)
ssp_colors_viridis <- c(
  "SSP1-1.9" = "#440154",  # Dark purple
  "SSP1-2.6" = "#31688E",  # Blue
  "SSP2-4.5" = "#35B779",  # Teal/cyan
  "SSP3-7.0" = "#90D743",  # Light green
  "SSP5-8.5" = "#FDE725"   # Yellow
)

# Alternative color scheme (plasma)
ssp_colors_plasma <- c(
  "SSP1-1.9" = "#0d0887",  # Deep purple
  "SSP1-2.6" = "#8606a6",  # Purple
  "SSP2-4.5" = "#c03a83",  # Pink
  "SSP3-7.0" = "#e76f5a",  # Orange
  "SSP5-8.5" = "#fcd225"   # Yellow
)

# ===========================
# STEP 7: Create unified faceted plot (absolute area) - VIRIDIS
# ===========================

unified_plot_viridis <- ggplot(all_data, aes(x = Decade_factor, y = Area_km2, 
                                    color = SSP_label, linetype = Pattern)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = interaction(SSP_label, Pattern)), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ factor(Marine_Zone, levels = c("Total Area", "State Waters", 
                                            "Commonwealth Waters", "High Seas")), 
             scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = ssp_colors_viridis, name = "SSP Scenario") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("suitable" = "dashed", "optimal" = "solid"),
                       name = "Pattern") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Climate Analogue Areas: Unconstrained Analysis by Marine Zone (Viridis)",
    x = "Decade",
    y = "Area (km²)"
  )

# Display and save
print(unified_plot_viridis)
ggsave(here("Figures/Area_plot/Unified_faceted_unconstrained_viridis.png"), 
       plot = unified_plot_viridis, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

# ===========================
# STEP 7B: Create unified faceted plot (absolute area) - PLASMA
# ===========================

unified_plot_plasma <- ggplot(all_data, aes(x = Decade_factor, y = Area_km2, 
                                    color = SSP_label, linetype = Pattern)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = interaction(SSP_label, Pattern)), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ factor(Marine_Zone, levels = c("Total Area", "State Waters", 
                                            "Commonwealth Waters", "High Seas")), 
             scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = ssp_colors_plasma, name = "SSP Scenario") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("suitable" = "dashed", "optimal" = "solid"),
                       name = "Pattern") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Climate Analogue Areas: Unconstrained Analysis by Marine Zone (Plasma)",
    x = "Decade",
    y = "Area (km²)"
  )

# Display and save
print(unified_plot_plasma)
ggsave(here("Figures/Area_plot/Unified_faceted_unconstrained_plasma.png"), 
       plot = unified_plot_plasma, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

# ===========================
# STEP 8: Calculate percent loss for second plot
# ===========================

calculate_percent_loss <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    group_by(SSP_label, Pattern, Marine_Zone) %>%
    arrange(Decade_factor) %>%
    mutate(
      baseline_area = first(Area_km2),  # 2021-2030 as baseline
      percent_change = ((Area_km2 - baseline_area) / baseline_area) * 100
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# Apply percent loss calculation
all_data_loss <- all_data %>%
  calculate_percent_loss()

# ===========================
# STEP 9: Create percent loss faceted plot - VIRIDIS
# ===========================

percent_loss_plot_viridis <- ggplot(all_data_loss, aes(x = Decade_factor, y = percent_change, 
                                              color = SSP_label, linetype = Pattern)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linetype = "dotted", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(aes(group = interaction(SSP_label, Pattern)), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ factor(Marine_Zone, levels = c("Total Area", "State Waters", 
                                            "Commonwealth Waters", "High Seas")), 
             scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = ssp_colors_viridis, name = "SSP Scenario") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("suitable" = "dashed", "optimal" = "solid"),
                       name = "Pattern") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Climate Analogue Area Change: Percent Loss by Marine Zone (Viridis)",
    subtitle = "Relative to 2021-2030 baseline (positive = loss, negative = gain)",
    x = "Decade",
    y = "Area Change (%)"
  )

# Display and save
print(percent_loss_plot_viridis)
ggsave(here("Figures/Area_plot/Unified_faceted_percent_loss_unconstrained_viridis.png"), 
       plot = percent_loss_plot_viridis, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

# ===========================
# STEP 9B: Create percent loss faceted plot - PLASMA
# ===========================

percent_loss_plot_plasma <- ggplot(all_data_loss, aes(x = Decade_factor, y = percent_change, 
                                              color = SSP_label, linetype = Pattern)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linetype = "dotted", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(aes(group = interaction(SSP_label, Pattern)), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ factor(Marine_Zone, levels = c("Total Area", "State Waters",

             scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +

  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Climate Analogue Area Change: Percent Loss by Marine Zone (Plasma)",
    subtitle = "Relative to 2021-2030 baseline (positive = loss, negative = gain)",
    x = "Decade",
    y = "Area Change (%)"

# Display and save
print(percent_loss_plot_plasma)
ggsave(here("Figures/Area_plot/Unified_faceted_percent_loss_unconstrained_plasma.png"),

# ===========================

# ===========================

cat("\n=== SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")
```
